text: Artificial intelligence is changing the way we work. Automation now handles many repetitive tasks, which saves time and reduces mistakes. Productivity tools powered by AI, such as smart calendars and writing assistants, help employees focus on more important work. Many companies are also exploring human-AI collaboration, where people and machines solve problems together. However, these changes affect jobs. Some roles may disappear, while new ones will appear, so workers need to learn new skills. Overall, AI can make workplaces more efficient, but it is important to manage the changes carefully and support employees through them.
